rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Verify MaxDate is within allowable 3-year publication lag and values are within [0, 100] for active recurring health indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Percent_Person_50To74Years_Female_ReceivedMammography_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_WithHighCholesterol', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_FastFoodConsumption3OrMoreTimesPerWeek', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Obesity_WithLimitation', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WalkableNeighborhood', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WithLimitation', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreeningPre2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreeningPre2012Guidelines_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years47To68_HepatitisCTestingEver', 'Percent_Person_Years50To75_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_DrivingWhileIntoxicated', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_HousingInsecurity', 'Percent_Person_Years18To44_Female_ReceivedDentalVisit', 'Percent_Person_Years18To64_Female_ReceivedAnnualCheckup', 'Percent_Person_Years21To29_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years55To69_Male_ProstateSpecificAntigenScreeningSharedDecision', 'Percent_Person_21To65Years_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_50To75Years_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years50To64_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_WithFallPastYear', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_WithFallWithInjuryPastYear', 'Percent_Person_18To64Years_Female_WithHealthInsurance', 'Percent_Person_ReceivedCholesterolScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_ActiveTransportation', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_Obesity', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_Smoking', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_WithCardiovascularDisease', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_DiabetesOrPrediabetesTesting', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_MedicalCannabisUse', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Obesity_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Smoking_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Smoking_WithMentalHealthNotGood', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WithTwoOrMoreAdverseChildhoodExperiences', 'Percent_Person_Years18To24_Smoking', 'Percent_Person_Years18To44_Female_ReceivedAnnualCheckup', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_ReceivedInfluenzaVaccineReceived')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND total_svs >= 38 AND NumPlaces >= 50 AND MinValue >= 0 AND MaxValue <= 100

rules.description: Verify MaxDate is at least the last published survey wave (2014, 2016, 2018, or 2021) and values are within [0, 100] for discontinued historical BRFSS indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Percent_Person_50To74Years_Female_ReceivedMammography_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_WithHighCholesterol', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_FastFoodConsumption3OrMoreTimesPerWeek', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Obesity_WithLimitation', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WalkableNeighborhood', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WithLimitation', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreeningPre2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreeningPre2012Guidelines_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years47To68_HepatitisCTestingEver', 'Percent_Person_Years50To75_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_DrivingWhileIntoxicated', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_HousingInsecurity', 'Percent_Person_Years18To44_Female_ReceivedDentalVisit', 'Percent_Person_Years18To64_Female_ReceivedAnnualCheckup', 'Percent_Person_Years21To29_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years55To69_Male_ProstateSpecificAntigenScreeningSharedDecision', 'Percent_Person_21To65Years_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_50To75Years_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years50To64_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_WithFallPastYear', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_WithFallWithInjuryPastYear', 'Percent_Person_18To64Years_Female_WithHealthInsurance', 'Percent_Person_ReceivedCholesterolScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_ActiveTransportation', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_Obesity', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_Smoking', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_WithCardiovascularDisease', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_DiabetesOrPrediabetesTesting', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_MedicalCannabisUse', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Obesity_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Smoking_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Smoking_WithMentalHealthNotGood', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WithTwoOrMoreAdverseChildhoodExperiences', 'Percent_Person_Years18To24_Smoking', 'Percent_Person_Years18To44_Female_ReceivedAnnualCheckup', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_ReceivedInfluenzaVaccineReceived')
params.condition: (CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Percent_Person_18To64Years_Female_WithHealthInsurance', 'Percent_Person_ReceivedCholesterolScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_ActiveTransportation', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_Obesity', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_Smoking', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_AnyDisability_WithCardiovascularDisease', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_DiabetesOrPrediabetesTesting', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_MedicalCannabisUse', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Obesity_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Smoking_IncomeOf0To24999USDollar', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_Smoking_WithMentalHealthNotGood', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_WithTwoOrMoreAdverseChildhoodExperiences', 'Percent_Person_Years18To24_Smoking', 'Percent_Person_Years18To44_Female_ReceivedAnnualCheckup', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_ReceivedInfluenzaVaccineReceived') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2021 WHEN StatVar IN ('Percent_Person_21To65Years_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_50To75Years_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years50To64_ReceivedColorectalCancerScreening', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_WithFallPastYear', 'Percent_Person_Years65Onwards_WithFallWithInjuryPastYear') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2018 WHEN StatVar IN ('Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_DrivingWhileIntoxicated', 'Percent_Person_Years18Onwards_HousingInsecurity', 'Percent_Person_Years18To44_Female_ReceivedDentalVisit', 'Percent_Person_Years18To64_Female_ReceivedAnnualCheckup', 'Percent_Person_Years21To29_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years21To65_Female_ReceivedCervicalCancerScreening2012Guidelines', 'Percent_Person_Years55To69_Male_ProstateSpecificAntigenScreeningSharedDecision') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2016 ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2014 END) AND total_svs >= 37 AND MinValue >= 0 AND MaxValue <= 100
